maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly royalties on GSK respiratory drugs (Breo, Anoro, Trelegy) plus new anti-infective product sales, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Royalties come from GSK, paid by commercial and government insurers and patients; payer mix is mixed, not mostly government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through royalty income and its own specialty therapies; Entasis and La Jolla deals are occasional, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Passive royalty stream from GSK's contracted respiratory products; customers (GSK) don't depend on Innoviva operationally and patients can switch inhalers.

notes: Public funding share of royalty revenue is uncertain; answered no given mixed payers including Medicare and commercial insurers.
